class.name: JRPGAutotile
class.brief_description: The shapes of Talewright's autotiles and where each one sits on a template sheet.
class.description: A blob autotile (terrain, water, paths) has one tile for each of the 47 shapes an 8-neighbor mask can take once its corners are reduced: a corner neighbor counts only when both sides next to it are the same kind. Shape [i]i[/i] is the [i]i[/i]-th reduced mask in ascending order and sits at column [i]i[/i] mod 8, row [i]i[/i] div 8 of an 8 x 6 sheet. A wall autotile has 16 shapes, one per 4-neighbor mask, at column [i]m[/i] mod 4, row [i]m[/i] div 4 of a 4 x 4 sheet. The guide [code]talewright/docs/autotile_template.md[/code] lists every shape. Pure logic without nodes: the importer, the map's autotile resolver and the game servers share it.

method.name: get_blob_cell
method.description: Returns the sheet cell (column, row) of blob shape [param index].

method.name: get_blob_index
method.description: Returns the blob shape index (0 to 46) of any 8-neighbour [param mask]. The mask is reduced first.

method.name: get_blob_mask
method.description: Returns the reduced mask of blob shape [param index], or [code]-1[/code] when [param index] is not 0 to 46.

method.name: get_wall_cell
method.description: Returns the sheet cell (column, row) of wall shape [param mask4] (0 to 15).

method.name: get_wall_mask
method.description: Returns the 4-neighbour wall mask (its N, E, S and W bits) of an 8-neighbour [param mask].

method.name: reduce_mask
method.description: Returns [param mask] (0 to 255) with each corner bit cleared unless both of its sides are set.
